## About Latte translations

Latte's Korean (ko) translations are hand-reviewed by the developer.
The other 9 languages (ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, de, fr, pt-BR, it, ru)
were drafted with LLM assistance and are explicitly invited to be
improved by native speakers. See [TRANSLATIONS.md](../../TRANSLATIONS.md)
for the full contributor guide.

Thanks for helping make Latte better in your language.
